title: Natures Aura Altered
description: My version of textures for the Natures Aura mod.
body:
My version of textures for the Natures Aura mod.

I tried to stick to a more vanilla color palette, while keeping the identity of the mod intact. At the same time, I was trying to add interconnectivity to the textures and their block functionality.

I am very new to texture creation and ready to accept any criticism and suggestions.
